name: tpch_q3_sf1
sql: SELECT l.l_orderkey, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, o.o_orderdate, o.o_shippriority FROM tpch.sf1.customer c, tpch.sf1.orders o, tpch.sf1.lineitem l WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey AND l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-03-15' AND l.l_shipdate > DATE '1995-03-15' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_shippriority ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate LIMIT 10
